text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Symboli Kris S is in the lead!! Symboli 
Kris S in front!! Symboli Kris S crosses 
the finish line!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S takes a magnificent 
victory--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (...This is not the end.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(From here, it begins once more. My path 
as an "ordeal." Therefore—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Next.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Good grief. Looks like our "trial" is 
already looking ahead and taking her next 
steps.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. That is precisely why we must— 
keep our eyes on the future and keep 
running...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Haha! And so we'll just keep burning 
bright, on and on! I love it—now I'm 
getting pumped!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...I've made up my mind!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy. I'm going to France next year!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Does that mean—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ah—I shall challenge the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
And I'll show my "romance" to the whole 
wide world!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"If we don't go that far— this fire 
ignited in me by her is never gonna die 
down!!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll... follow the same Autumn Senior 
Triple Crown path as Kris S-san and get 
results...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...No, that alone won't be enough. If I 
want to surpass that person—"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Total conquest of the Senior Year royal 
road...! This is the path I must follow!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
To overcome the "ordeal"— and proclaim 
myself a "hero"!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "That's awesome! Now that's thrilling!!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It all begins here, Rob Roy. Our... 
endless journey!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That was the greatest Arima Kinen in 
history...! I'll never forget this race 
for the rest of my life! Thank you, 
Symboli Kris S!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That was such a thrilling race~~~...! And 
Kris S is totally unshakable~~~! Still as 
cool as ever... I totally stan her!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is burning so hot... and shining 
so brightly. ...So much that it makes my 
own soul tremble.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm truly glad I invited you to Japan back 
then. ...Thank you, Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...I have witnessed it all. The entire 
battle history of your rebellion against 
the world.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And you—you bear a mortal sin. Destroying 
destiny, plunging the world into chaos—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
For she questioned where the passion lay, 
even from someone like me who has 
accomplished everything and now sits in 
the shadows...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh hehâ The time for the 'Answer' draws 
near, does itâ

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――……Mission accomplished.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yeah. —This is... not our end.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
—Kris Sss! Congratulationsss!! Thank you 
for such an incredible, moving raceee!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Keep doing your best!! Show us plenty of 
incredible races!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. —May I—make my declaration 
here?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
What I will... continue to achieve―― 
without ever wavering.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Right here, right now—I want to put it 
into words.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Thanks. Well then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S picks up the microphone for 
post-race comments—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Here and now... Allow me—to make a 
declaration.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I will... continue to— 
unwaveringly...—deliver "results"...—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
As a champion...— I must keep aiming—for 
the top...—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I will do my utmost... to become a 
'trial'... for the Umamusume running in 
this era."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
All of it... is to bring about a 
"revolution"—to the Japanese racing world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S's powerful declaration 
shook not just Nakayama Racecourse, but 
all of Japan...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And time marches on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for a "revolution," a brand-new 
world—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yeah. —Let's begin today just like always.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Our... "mission."
